title: DeepSeek releases V3.2 and V3.2-Speciale with open weights, first DeepSeek model combining reasoning with tool use
summary: DeepSeek published V3.2 as its default model on web, app and API and released weights for both models on Hugging Face and ModelScope, with Speciale offered through a temporary research API.

title: GPU maker Moore Threads lists on Shanghai STAR Market, closes first day up about 425% after raising nearly 8bn yuan
summary: Moore Threads priced shares at 114.28 yuan, raised about 8 billion yuan in the year's largest STAR Market IPO and closed its debut at 600.50 yuan for a market value of about 282 billion yuan.

title: Trump says US will allow Nvidia H200 sales to approved customers in China, with 25% of proceeds going to the US government
summary: Trump announced that Nvidia may ship H200 chips to approved customers in China and other countries subject to national-security conditions and a 25% revenue share, while Blackwell and Rubin chips stay excluded.

title: Google releases Gemini 3 Flash and makes it the default model in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode
summary: Google launched Gemini 3 Flash as a faster, lower-cost version of its flagship model, replacing Gemini 2.5 Flash in the Gemini app and as the default in Search AI Mode.

title: ByteDance launches Doubao 1.8 model with stronger tool use and multimodal agent abilities at Volcano Engine Force conference
summary: ByteDance's Volcano Engine introduced Doubao-Seed-1.8, which it says improves tool calling and multimodal agent capabilities.

title: Moonshot AI, developer of Kimi, closes 500 million dollar Series C round, BAAI review reports
summary: Moonshot AI completed a 500 million dollar Series C financing and reported cash reserves above 10 billion yuan.

title: MiniMax and Zhipu pass Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing hearings in bids to become first listed large-model company
summary: Chinese model developers MiniMax and Zhipu both cleared HKEX listing hearings in December, according to BAAI's 2025 review.

title: Putin says Russia will not ban foreign neural networks such as ChatGPT but requires their developers to comply with Russian law
summary: At his year-end press conference Putin said Russia is not prohibiting foreign AI services and that restrictions would follow only if market participants fail to comply with Russian laws.

title: Swedish vibe-coding startup Lovable raises 330 million dollars at a 6.6 billion dollar valuation
summary: Lovable, which builds apps from natural-language prompts, raised 330 million dollars at a 6.6 billion dollar valuation, as noted in Habr's 2025 AI review.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2 after reportedly accelerating its timeline in response to Google's progress
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.2, which it reported scored 70.9% on its GDPval benchmark versus 38.8% for GPT-5.1.

title: White House executive order seeks single national AI framework and creates task force to challenge state AI laws
summary: The order sets up an AI Litigation Task Force to contest state AI laws that conflict with a lighter-touch national standard and tells agencies to draft a federal reporting and disclosure standard for AI models.

title: Microsoft announces 17.5 billion dollar investment in India cloud and AI infrastructure, its largest in Asia
summary: Microsoft committed 17.5 billion dollars to expand cloud and AI infrastructure in India.

title: Nvidia unveils new family of open-source AI models
summary: Nvidia released a new family of open-source AI models that it described as faster and cheaper than its earlier offerings.

title: Mistral releases open-weight Mistral Large 3 under Apache 2.0 and Devstral 2 coding models
summary: Mistral published Large 3, a 675-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model under Apache 2.0, along with Devstral 2 coding models in 123B and 24B sizes.

title: Anthropic publishes Project Vend phase two, finding its shop-running AI agent still struggled despite better tools
summary: Anthropic reported that its Claudius agent, given a CRM, inventory tools and web browsing to run an office shop, still fell short of reliable real-world performance.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic and Block form Agentic AI Foundation under Linux Foundation to steward MCP, AGENTS.md and Goose
summary: The new foundation places the Model Context Protocol, AGENTS.md and the Goose agent framework under neutral open-source governance at the Linux Foundation.

title: Amazon announces additional 35 billion dollar investment in India, bringing planned total to 75 billion dollars by 2030
summary: Amazon said it will invest a further 35 billion dollars in India, taking its planned investment there to 75 billion dollars by 2030.

title: Alphabet acquires clean energy developer Intersect Power for about 5 billion dollars to power data centres
summary: Alphabet bought Intersect Power for nearly 5 billion dollars and partnered with NextEra Energy on additional generating capacity.

title: Report alleges DeepSeek used smuggled Nvidia Blackwell chips; Nvidia denies the claim
summary: Media reports alleged that DeepSeek trained models on Nvidia Blackwell chips brought into China around US export controls, which Nvidia denied.

title: OpenAI reaches 1 billion dollar deal with Disney
summary: OpenAI and Disney concluded a deal valued at 1 billion dollars, according to the December 2025 AI roundup.
